serving_lanes.detail: Research identity for the native E2M1 A=W route. It deliberately declares no route_status_source: the producer knows the W4A4 execution shape from the lane source, but the pinned runtime publishes no attestation table. ServingLaneSpec therefore resolves route_status=unattested and that structured refusal travels on every candidate; it is never hand-written as backed.

_emulation_only_rationale: Declares NO export_lane and is not shippable. It exists so the continuous trellis rate surface can be ALLOCATED against a capability gate that actually fires. The generic `research` profile declares no target_platform, and trellis_allocator._capability_gate returns legal for every family when the platform is None -- a gate that cannot compare anything is provenance, not a gate (principle 9). Naming sm_121 here makes the E2M1 SM120+ and E4M3 SM89+ floors real comparisons against the GB10 the anchors were measured on.
description: RESEARCH-ONLY allocation profile for the Gridbook rate-256 tail-biting trellis families on GB10 (Blackwell sm_121). It admits the closed TCQ_E2M1/TCQ_E4M3 rate vocabulary plus the scalar terminals an honest mixed menu needs, so a DP can rank a continuous trellis rung against NVFP4/FP8/BF16 in one currency. It makes NO serving claim: the producer Gridbook pin publishes no executed-activation-contract table, so every lane here resolves route_status `unattested` and export fails closed. A trellis rung selected under this profile is a REPORT about where the allocator would spend bytes, not an artifact.
_no_format_rules_rationale: Deliberately declares NO format_rules, so check_serving_format admits everything -- exactly like the generic `research` profile it exists beside. Naming the 2546 addressable TCQ rungs in an allow list would assert they are format_registry entries, and they are not: a trellis rung has no RTN quantize_dequantize and no FormatSpec. Its value-bearing renderer is intentionally outside the scalar registry and requires an exact TrellisEncodePlan; registering 2546 stubs would put plan-less names in front of every menu-construction path to buy a bound the manifest already supplies. The menu here is bounded by PRISMAQUANT_TRELLIS_SURFACE's measured anchors on the trellis side and by FORMATS + check_format_applicability on the scalar side; what this profile adds is the one thing neither of those can -- an exact target_platform, so trellis_allocator._capability_gate compares SM121 against the E2M1 SM120+ / E4M3 SM89+ floors instead of returning legal without comparing anything.
